source: live click-through 2026-11-01 (fresh F2P account) + osrs cache + OSRS wiki

npc.name: Adventurer Jon
talk_options: Do you have any Adventure Path starter kits for me?
I'd like to claim my Adventure Path rewards.
Can you show me some Adventure Paths?

tasks.name: Getting started with Attack
tasks.description: Reach level 5 in the Attack skill.
hints: Ensure your combat style is set to provide Attack XP. The Men, Chickens and Goblins near Lumbridge are suitable targets to fight.

tasks.name: Getting a grip on it
tasks.description: Reach level 10 in the Attack skill.
hints: Ensure your combat style is set to provide Attack XP. Cows and Farmers around Lumbridge are suitable targets to fight.

tasks.name: Weapons master
tasks.description: Reach level 20 in the Attack skill.
hints: Ensure your combat style is set to provide Attack XP. The Barbarians south of Edgeville are suitable targets to fight.

tasks.name: Getting started with Ranged
tasks.description: Reach level 5 in the Ranged skill.
hints: Ensure you have a Ranged weapon for your level with usable ammo. Arrows you fire can be picked up from the ground.

tasks.name: Honing my aim
tasks.description: Reach level 10 in the Ranged skill.
hints: Ensure you have a Ranged weapon for your level with usable ammo. Cows and Farmers around Lumbridge are suitable targets to fight.

tasks.description: Reach level 20 in the Ranged skill.
hints: Ensure you have a Ranged weapon for your level with usable ammo. The Frogs south of Lumbridge and Wizards west of Lumbridge are suitable targets to fight.

tasks.name: Getting started with Magic
tasks.description: Reach level 5 in the Magic skill.
hints: Ensure you have runes for a spell you can cast at your Magic level. The Men, Chickens and Goblins near Lumbridge are suitable targets to fight.

tasks.name: Striking a pose
tasks.description: Reach level 10 in the Magic skill.
hints: Ensure you have runes for a spell you can cast at your Magic level. Cows and Farmers around Lumbridge are suitable targets to fight.

tasks.name: Bringer of chaos

hints: Ensure you have runes for a spell you can cast at your Magic level. The Frogs in the swamp south of Lumbridge are suitable targets to fight.

tasks.name: Getting started with Fishing
tasks.description: Reach level 5 in the Fishing skill.
hints: You can find fishing spots by looking at the Mini-map and World map for the icon <img=18>. You can get a fishing net from the Fishing Tutor, south of Lumbridge graveyard.

tasks.name: Getting started with Woodcutting
tasks.description: Reach level 5 in the Woodcutting skill.
hints: You can find trees to chop by looking at the Mini-map and World map for tree icons that look similar to this icon <img=16>. You can get an axe from the Woodcutting Tutor.

tasks.name: Getting started with Mining
tasks.description: Reach level 5 in the Mining skill.
hints: You can find rocks to mine by looking at the Mini-map and World map for the icon <img=17>. You can get a pickaxe from the Mining Tutor, south of Lumbridge graveyard.

gatherer.reward: Lamp of the Gatherer (24528): 150 XP in Woodcutting, Fishing or Mining, one use
